datasets.title: Netherlands Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 11.5 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 93% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 1 year, 8 days ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 6% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['building'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en building building:levels building:materials addr:full addr:housenumber addr:street addr:city office source name:nl This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap as volunteered geographic information and exported in multiple geospatial formats (KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage, Shapefile). Coverage completeness was assessed against AI-mapped estimates, with data currency tracked through edit timestamps.
